note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `meta` grows key by key across rounds: the datasets-server infers a six-key `meta` struct from the early shards, then cannot cast the later records that add `domain` / `stack` / `lane` / `zone` and the two keys `product` / `mechanic` that only the sixteen dest-stamped rows carry, so no parquet index is built. Declaring the union — with `meta`, `reward` and `tool_call.args` as `json` key-bags — fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: present on 6112 of 6112 records and never empty; unlike the sibling `long-horizon-coding-trajectories` declaration, `plan` is mandatory in this dataset

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool and also within one tool — `pytest` takes `args` on 11370 steps and `target` on 1122, while `write` (16 steps, all on the dest-stamped rows) takes `contents` + `path`

list.name: reflection
list.note: present on 71549 of 101200 steps (71269 of 100920 episode steps, and all 280 steps of the sixteen dest-stamped rows)

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag with 1074 distinct keys over 6112 records: `success`, `tests_passed`, `cost_steps` on every record; `retries` on 6096 (every `meta.kind=episode` record, none of the sixteen `designed` rows); `duration_min` and `wasted_calls` on 5736 each; `handoff` on 39 records where it is a string on 31 episodes and an int on the 8 dest-stamped rows that carry it; `xfailed` on 8, all dest-stamped; the remaining ~1060 keys are per-episode counters such as `rows`, `rows_after`, `oom`, `lag_h`

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `round`, `generator`, `kind` on every record; `seed` and `designed` on the 6096 `episode` records only; `domain` and `stack` on 5736; `lane` on 4490; `zone` on 70; `product` and `mechanic` only on the sixteen `designed` dest-stamped rows

disclosures.summary: Sixteen records in `batch-r2623.jsonl`–`batch-r2630.jsonl` are cache leftover-mill products (`dbc-*` ids, `meta.kind=designed`, `meta.product` / `meta.mechanic`, container build-cache subjects) that were dest-stamped `meta.factory=data-pipeline-repair-factory`. They are the same leftover-mill class already censused elsewhere, not a new one, and they are the only records in this dataset that carry `product` / `mechanic` or that omit `meta.seed`, `meta.designed` and `reward.retries`. They are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: The other 6096 records are `data-pipeline-repair-factory` schema-drift and late-data episodes generated by `grok-4.6` (`dpr-*` ids, `meta.kind=episode`). The word "leftover" appears in 1182 of their goals and 1584 of their outcomes because leftover state is this factory's own advertised repair mechanic; that is not a foreign payload, and no `dpr-*` id contains "leftover".
Every one of the 101200 steps publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought`, `chain_of_thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
The declared config covers all 3056 published shards `batch-r01.jsonl`–`batch-r3056.jsonl` (no gaps), 6112 records, 0 parse failures.
